name: Mauricio Ramirez L.
headline: Back-End Software Engineer | Backend Systems | REST API Design | Microservices | DevOps Practices | CI/CD | Containerization | Cloud Platforms | AI-Assisted Development/Code Review | AI Coding Agents
summary: Back-End Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience building and scaling distributed systems in finance and retail. Specialized in .NET, microservices, and cloud architectures, with a proven track record of improving performance, reliability, and deployment efficiency in remote, cross-functional teams. Experienced in leveraging AI coding agents to accelerate development, streamline debugging, and strengthen code review practices.

bullets: Designed and developed 10+ scalable microservices using .NET Framework/Core, supporting inventory forecasting systems processing millions of records daily.
Built and optimized RESTful APIs, reducing average response time by 25–35% through improved error handling, caching, and versioning strategies.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), decreasing deployment time by 40% and enabling multiple weekly releases.
Enforced code quality practices (SonarQube, unit testing), reducing production defects by 30% and improving maintainability.

Integrated AI coding agents (Claude, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex) into daily development workflows, reducing turnaround time on standard tasks by up to 75% (cutting typical 2–3 day tasks to half a day to 1 day) and accelerating new API scaffolding from multiple days to 1–2 days, while driving broader team adoption of AI-assisted development practices.

Applied AI agents to support debugging, root-cause analysis, and code review — speeding up diagnosis of intermittent production issues and flagging edge cases, null-reference risks, and inconsistent error handling before pull requests reached human reviewers, improving code quality and review turnaround.
Standardized CI/CD workflows across services, increasing deployment success rate to >95%.
Contributed to high-volume backend systems supporting a global retail client, enabling scalable inventory processing and decision-making.
Reduced time-to-resolution on recurring backend issues by pairing traditional debugging with AI-agent-assisted root-cause analysis.
Developed microservices in .NET and Java for financial transaction systems handling high-volume digital credit operations.
Implemented asynchronous processing and integrations (JBoss Fuse), improving system throughput by 30% and reducing latency in transaction flows.
Centralized business rules using JBoss BRMS, reducing manual intervention and accelerating credit approval processes by 20–25%.
Participated in system design, improving system resilience and reducing service downtime through fault-tolerant patterns.
Delivered backend services powering digital credit and mobile wallet platforms used in production.
Eliminated operational bottlenecks by automating decision logic, improving processing efficiency and consistency.
Developed backend APIs and web applications using .NET Core and SQL Server, supporting business operations with improved data accessibility and performance.
Optimized SQL queries and stored procedures, reducing reporting execution time by 30–40%.
Built Power BI dashboards that enabled stakeholders to make faster, data-driven decisions, reducing reporting turnaround time from days to hours.
Maintained and enhanced HR and finance systems, improving system reliability and reducing support incidents by 20%.
Developed reporting tools that streamlined administrative workflows, saving dozens of manual hours per month.
Collaborated with stakeholders to implement system improvements aligned with operational needs.
